notes.title: Color Escape Playtest has begun. Join!
notes.content:
Friends, we are happy to announce the start of the playtest of our game! 🚀 This is your chance to try the game before anyone else, share your impressions and help us make it even better.

How to participate:
1️⃣ Click the "Request access" button on the game page.
2️⃣ Install the game and invite your friends to play.

Please note that the game levels are currently designed for at least 2 games.

Don't forget to take the survey after the game - this will help us understand what you like or don't like about the game.
